bachelor_required.value: 4-year bachelor degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline
bachelor_required.quote: An applicant must hold a 4-year bachelor degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline with a minimum major average of 70%

non_cs_notes.value: No alternative pathway or experience substitution stated; 5+ grades below 70% in CS courses reduces chances
non_cs_notes.quote: 4-year bachelor's degree in computer science or related discipline

min_gpa.value: Minimum major average 70%, or 77% in last 3 years of study

ielts.value: 6.5, no more than one band at 6.0 (no band below 6.0)

english_waiver.value: Exempt if degree completed at an institution in a country where English was primary language of instruction (list includes Nigeria) within past two years

other_requirements.value: Statement of Interest, resume/CV, two letters of reference; $4,000 deposit within 21 days of admission

duration.quote: four (4) consecutive academic terms or 16 months

coop_internship.value: Final-term research project or internship; co-op option per program page

eligibility_notes: Provisional: requires CS or 'closely-related discipline' with a 70% major average; a geography degree is unlikely to count and no experience route is stated, but not explicitly 'no alternatives', so not rejected. English waiver likely (Nigeria exemption, but within two years of graduation, which may fail depending on graduation year TODO). Fall deadline May 15, 2027, fee $125.
